questions.question: A man bought 2 articles for Rs. 3050 each. He sold one article at 10% loss and another at 20% profit. The total profit/loss percentage he earned is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

When the **Cost Price (CP)** of two articles is the **same**, the net profit or loss percentage is the **arithmetic mean** of the individual profit/loss percentages.

Net Profit/Loss % = (Percentage 1 + Percentage 2) ÷ 2

Net % = (−10% + 20%) ÷ 2 = 10% ÷ 2 = 5%

Since the result is **positive**, it is a **profit**.

**∴ The correct answer is 5% profit.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

CP of Article 1 = ₹3050

CP of Article 2 = ₹3050

Loss on Article 1 = 10%

Profit on Article 2 = 20%

**Formula Used:**

Selling Price (SP) = CP × (100 ± Profit/Loss %) ÷ 100

Profit % = (Total SP − Total CP) ÷ Total CP × 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17587968226e9c02cc8b589b9473304bbecf3b8b9c61a57b961032c057f73ce0.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total CP = 3050 + 3050 = ₹6100

⇒ SP₁ = 3050 × (90 ÷ 100) = ₹2745

⇒ SP₂ = 3050 × (120 ÷ 100) = ₹3660

⇒ Total SP = 2745 + 3660 = ₹6405

⇒ Net Profit = 6405 − 6100 = ₹305

⇒ Net Profit % = (305 ÷ 6100) × 100

⇒ Net Profit % = 5%

**∴ The correct answer is 5% profit.**

**__Additional Information__**

Same Selling Price Case

If two articles are sold at the **same Selling Price (SP)**, one at x% profit and another at x% loss, there is always a net loss of (x/10)² %.

Profit and Loss Basics

Profit % and Loss % are always calculated on the **Cost Price (CP)** unless stated otherwise in the question.

Successive Percentage Change

For two successive changes of a% and b%, the net effective change is given by [a + b + (a × b ÷ 100)]%.

questions.question: If 2 sin²θ + 5 cos θ – 4 = 0, 0° < θ < 90°, then the value of cot θ + cosec θ is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

2 sin²θ + 5 cos θ – 4 = 0

**Concept used:**

• sin2θ = (1 – cos2θ) 

**Calculation:**

2 sin2θ + 5 cos θ – 4 = 0

⇒ 2 (1 – cos²θ) + 5 cos θ – 4 = 0

⇒ 2 – 2 cos² θ + 5 cos θ – 4 = 0

⇒ 2 cos²θ – 5 cos θ + 2 = 0

⇒ 2 cos²θ – 4 cos θ – cos θ + 2 = 0

⇒ 2 cos θ (cos θ – 2) – 1 (cos θ – 2) = 0

⇒ (2 cos θ – 1) (cos θ – 2) = 0

⇒ cos θ = 1/2 or cos θ = 2 (not possible)

∴ cos θ = 1/2 = cos 60°

∴ θ = 60°

Now

cot θ + cosec θ = cot 60° + cosec 60° = (1/√3) + (2/√3) = 3/√3 = √3

**∴ cot θ + cosec θ = √3**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

If we put θ = 60° this satisfies the equation 2 sin2θ + 5 cos θ – 4 = 0

So, the value of 

⇒ cot θ + cosec θ 

⇒ cot 60° + cosec 60°

⇒ (1/√3) + (2/√3)

⇒ √3

questions.question: Three number are in the ratio 1/2 : 2/3 : 3/4. The difference between the greatest and the smallest number is 27. The average of the three number is:
questions.solution:
The given ratio of three numbers

1/2 : 2/3 : 3/4

⇒ 6 : 8 : 9

Let the numbers be 6x, 8x and 9x

According to question

Difference between the greatest and the smallest number = 27

⇒ 9x – 6x = 27

⇒ 3x = 27

⇒ x = 9

The first number = 6x = 6 × 9 = 54

The Second number = 8x = 8 × 9 = 72

The third number = 9x = 9 × 9 = 81

Sum of three numbers = 54 + 72 + 81 = 207

∴ Average = 207/3 = 69

9 years ago, the average age of a family of five members was 33 years. Now, three new members join whose ages are in ascending order with consecutive gaps of 8 years. If the present average age of the family is the same as it was 9 years ago, what is the age (in years) of the eldest new member?
questions.solution:
9 years ago, The total age of 5 members = 33 × 5 = 165

Now total age of 8 members = 33 × 8 = 264

And total age of 5 members = 165 + 45 = 210

Total age of 3 new members = 264 – 210 = 54

Now let the age of new younger member = x

∴ age of middle member = x + 8

And age of eldest member = x + 16

According to question

x + x + 8 + x + 16 = 54

⇒ 3x + 24 = 54

⇒ 3x = 30

⇒ x = 10

∴ The age of eldest person = x + 16 = 10 + 16 = 26 year

questions.question: If 12 cot²θ – 31 cosec θ + 32 = 0, 0° < θ < 90°, then the values of sin θ will be:
questions.solution:
12 cot²θ – 31 cosec θ + 32 = 0

⇒ 12(cosec²θ – 1) – 31 cosec θ + 32 = 0

⇒ 12 cosec²θ – 12 – 31 cosec θ + 32 = 0

⇒ 12 cosec²θ – 31 cosec θ + 20 = 0

⇒ 12 cosec²θ – 16 cosec θ – 15 cosec θ + 20 = 0

⇒ 4 cosec θ (3 cosec θ – 4) – 5 (3 cosec θ – 4) = 0

⇒ (4 cosec θ – 5) (3 cosec θ – 4) = 0

⇒ cosec θ = 5/4 or cosec θ = 4/3

∴ sin θ = 4/5 or sin θ = 3/4

questions.question: If (2x - 7)³ + (2x – 8)³ + (2x - 3)³ = 3 (2x - 7) (2x - 8) (2x - 3), then what is the value of x?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(2x - 7)³ + (2x – 8)³ + (2x - 3)³ = 3 (2x - 7) (2x - 8) (2x – 3)

**Concept used:**

If a³ + b³ + c³ = 3abc then a + b + c = 0

**Calculation:**

Let's assume a = (2x - 7), b = (2x - 8), c = (2x – 3), so

a + b + c = 0

⇒ 2x – 7 + 2x – 8 + 2x – 3 = 0

⇒ 6x – 18 = 0

⇒ 6x = 18

**∴ x = 3**

questions.question: If a 10-digit number 6220x558y2 is divisible by 88, then the value of (5x + 5y) is:
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

If a number is divisible by 88 then it is must be divisible by 8 × 11

When a number is divisible by 8 then its last three digit is also divisible by 8

**Calculation:**

∴ 8y2 is divisible by 8 when y = 3

When a number is divisible by 11 then its difference of alternate sum of digit is equal to zero or 11.

Now,

In number 6220x55832

The difference between 6 + 2 + x + 5 + 3 and 2 + 0 + 5 + 8 + 2 must be zero or 11

The difference between (16 + x) and 17 will be zero or 11 when x = 1

**∴ 5x + 5y = 5 × 1 + 5 × 3 = 5 + 15 = 20**

questions.question: A certain amount invested at a certain rate, compounded annually, grows to an amount in three years, which is a factor of 1.191016 of principal. What is the rate percentage?
questions.solution:
**Formula used:**

Amount = Principal (1 + R/100)n

**Calculation:**

Let the principal and the amount be P and 1.191016P. 

⇒ 1.191016P = P(1 + R/100)³

⇒ 1.191016 = (1 + R/100)³

⇒ 1.06 = 1 + R/100

⇒ 0.06 = R/100

⇒ R = 6

**∴ The rate is 6%**

questions.question: A, B and C can complete a piece of work is 5, 20 and 60 days respectively, Working together, the same work in how many days?
questions.solution:
Given:

A can do the work = 5 days

B can do the work = 20 days

C can do the work = 60 days

Calculation:

One-day work of A = 1/5 days ----(1)

One-day work of B = 1/20 days ----(2)

One-day work of C = 1/60 days ----(3)

Adding equations (1), (2) and (3), we get

One-day work of (A + B + C) = {(1/5) + (1/20) + (1/60)}

⇒ (A + B + C) = {(12 + 3 + 1)/60}

⇒ (A + B + C) = 16/60 = 15/4 

One-day work of (A + B + C) = 15/4 days 

therefore {{work done by them together}} = frac{{60}}{{16}} = frac{{15}}{4} = 3(3)/(4) days

questions.question: If x⁴ + x⁻⁴ = 1442, (x > 0) then the value of x + x⁻¹ is:
questions.solution:
x⁴ + x⁻⁴ = 1442

⇒ x⁴ + 1/x⁴ = 1442

Adding 2 both sides

x⁴ + 1/x⁴ + 2 = 1442 + 2 = 1444

⇒ (x² + 1/x²)² = (38)²

⇒ x² + 1/x² = 38

Again adding 2 both sides

x² + 1/x² + 2 = 38 + 2 = 40

⇒ (x + 1/x)² = 40

⇒ x + 1/x = sqrt{40}

∴ x + x⁻¹ = 2sqrt {10}
